title: Complimentary Room Terms for Group Room Blocks
content:
Group Room Blocks earn complimentary room nights on paid room nights. Each block type sets how many paid room nights earn one complimentary room night, the most complimentary room nights per block, how a complimentary night is valued, whether nights are earned cumulatively over the whole block, and whether the credit includes room tax.

| Block type | Paid room nights that earn one complimentary room night | Most complimentary room nights per block |
|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | 50 | 4 |
| Wedding Room Block | 40 | 5 |
| Sports Team Room Block | 20 | 8 |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 20 | 10 |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | 40 | 10 |
| Association Convention Room Block | 50 | 30 |

| Term common to every block type | Setting |
|---|---|
| A complimentary room night is valued at | the group rate, room only |
| Earned on cumulative paid room nights over the whole block | Yes |
| Complimentary credit includes room tax | No |

### Questions the schedule answers

**What earns one complimentary night on a Wedding Room Block?** Every 40 paid room nights.

**What is the most a Sports Team Room Block can earn?** 8 complimentary room nights.

**Is the count made night by night or over the whole block?** Over the whole block: paid room nights are added up across all the block's nights before the ratio is read.

**Does the valuation include tax or extras?** No. A complimentary room night is valued at the group rate, room only, and the credit carries no room tax.

**Do two block types share the same ratio but different caps?** Yes. Tour & Travel Series Block and Sports Team Room Block both earn at 20 paid room nights, with caps of 10 and 8; Corporate Meeting Room Block and Wedding Room Block both earn at 40, with caps of 10 and 5.
